style_summary: A high-saturation editorial poster system that combines one low-angle full-body photographic cutout with oversized irregular orange display lettering, a cobalt-to-sky-blue field, flat green organic edge shapes, and tiny cream callouts. The look is playful, spacious, and street-culture adjacent without becoming grungy or collage-dense.

environment_variables.SUBJECT: main photographic subject
environment_variables.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: single foreground object or visual anchor
environment_variables.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: two or three restrained scene details
environment_variables.ACCENT_SYMBOL: small arrow, chevron, sparkle, or geometric mark
environment_variables.STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS: observable style traits that must remain visible
environment_variables.SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID: literal source content that generated samples must not recreate

style_fidelity_anchors: A saturated cobalt-to-sky-blue field fills nearly the entire frame, with only restrained environmental details allowed near the lower edge.
One crisp full-body photographic cutout dominates the center at roughly 55 to 70 percent of the frame height.
The camera sits below waist level with a mild wide-angle upward perspective that makes the subject and foreground anchor feel monumental.
A single oversized warm-orange headline spans the upper third, using solid-fill, chunky, hand-warped display letters on an uneven baseline.
The photographic subject overlaps and obscures part of the headline so type and portrait read as one layered composition.
Large flat botanical-green ribbons or amoebic blobs enter from two or more frame edges and behave as a loose organic border.
Tiny warm-cream or yellow arrow symbols and compact sans-serif microcopy occupy the side margins as sparse editorial callouts.
Thin cobalt registration bars, short underlines, or tiny geometric cuts interrupt selected orange letter edges as secondary accents.
The palette stays near 60 percent blue, 18 percent green, 17 percent orange, and 5 percent cream, with very high saturation and no neutral wash.
The photo treatment uses crisp cutout edges, punchy daylight contrast, saturated cool shadows, and warm highlights without heavy grain or halftone.
The layout remains sparse and poster-like: one subject, one foreground anchor, one headline, and no more than three micro-callout clusters.
The overall mood is upbeat, irreverent, youthful editorial street culture expressed through clean digital compositing rather than distressed zine texture.
source_content_to_avoid: The identifiable young Black man from the reference, including his face, cap, beard, expression, or body silhouette.
A person seated astride a large yellow or orange fire hydrant or any hydrant used as a pedestal.
The head-resting-on-hand pose, dangling seated posture, and legs framing the central pedestal.
The specific green crewneck sweater, baggy cobalt trousers, white crew socks, and white sneaker outfit combination.
The exact outdoor utility-street setting with the same power poles, overhead wires, and sky arrangement.
The exact orange headline letterforms and wording shown across the upper half of the source image.
The phrases ICONIC VIBES, The title doesn't matter Colors matter, and Dimensions are more important And the picture is art.
The source image's precise green squiggle paths, arrow placements, blue letter tabs, and microcopy coordinates.
Any watermark, username, creator signature, platform logo, brand mark, QR code, or identity mark.

visual_deconstruction.overall_style: Contemporary photo-cutout editorial poster with bold pop color blocking and playful hand-distorted display type.
visual_deconstruction.composition_logic: A vertical stack runs from giant background headline to central human cutout to one oversized foreground anchor; edge blobs and tiny side notes create asymmetrical balance.
visual_deconstruction.subject_placement: The subject is centered slightly below mid-frame, overlaps the headline, and remains readable as one isolated silhouette.
visual_deconstruction.camera_and_perspective: Low viewpoint with a restrained wide-angle lens; the nearest prop is enlarged while the background stays simple and nearly flat.
visual_deconstruction.typography_behavior: One short, loud, irregular orange word or phrase supplies mass; supporting text is tiny, clean, cream-colored, and secondary.
visual_deconstruction.color_behavior: Cobalt blue is the dominant field, orange carries headline and focal accents, green frames the image, and cream is reserved for micro-details.
visual_deconstruction.graphic_grammar: Broad organic edge ribbons, small directional arrows, short underlines, narrow registration tabs, and an occasional sparkle.
visual_deconstruction.texture_and_finish: Clean digital cutout compositing with slightly sharpened editorial photography, solid vector-like fills, and minimal surface noise.
visual_deconstruction.lighting: Hard-to-medium natural daylight with warm highlights, cool saturated shadows, and clear separation from the graphic background.
visual_deconstruction.mood: Confident, playful, colorful, youthful, and culturally current without relying on a specific person or brand.

composition.hierarchy: Headline first as a color mass, subject immediately after as the photographic focal point, foreground prop third, then microcopy and symbols.
composition.subject_scale: Keep the subject large and full-body, usually 55 to 70 percent of frame height, with a clean silhouette and no crowd.
composition.headline_zone: Place a single huge headline across the upper third or upper half, partially behind the subject, while preserving enough blue field to keep the layout breathable.
composition.foreground_anchor: Use one distinct object low in the frame to create depth; it may crop at the bottom but must not become a fire hydrant or imitate the source pedestal.
composition.edge_framing: Allow green organic shapes to enter from corners and sides, never covering the face, main gesture, or full headline.
composition.aspect_adaptation: For 4:5, use a taller central stack and stronger bottom crop. For 5:4, widen the headline and distribute callouts into the side margins while keeping one centered subject.

typography.display_face: Custom-looking chunky uppercase display letters with playful swelling, tapering, uneven widths, and an irregular hand-set baseline; solid orange fill with no outline.
typography.headline_length: Prefer one or two very short words totaling four to ten characters so the type can remain monumental.
typography.layering: The central photo cutout must overlap selected letters, while enough of every word remains inferable and visually dominant.
typography.microcopy: Use a compact geometric sans serif in warm cream, set in two to four short lines at a tiny scale and aligned near an accent arrow.
typography.accent_treatment: Add at most three small cobalt tabs, cuts, or short rules over orange letter edges; keep them secondary and crisp.

color_palette.deep_cobalt: #0043B8 — upper field, cool shadow reinforcement, registration details
color_palette.sky_blue: #579FE2 — lower field and subtle vertical atmospheric transition
color_palette.signal_orange: #FFA10A — giant headline and primary focal accents
color_palette.botanical_green: #40986B — flat organic edge ribbons and selective wardrobe notes
color_palette.warm_cream: #F4EED5 — microcopy, small symbols, footwear or tiny highlights
color_palette.distribution: Approximately 60 percent blue, 18 percent green, 17 percent orange, and 5 percent cream; avoid adding competing hues.

photographic_direction.subject_capture: Photoreal editorial full-body portrait, isolated with a clean digital cutout and believable anatomy.
photographic_direction.lens_and_angle: Use a 24 to 30 millimeter equivalent lens from a low camera position, with moderate foreground enlargement rather than extreme fisheye distortion.
photographic_direction.lighting: Bright outdoor daylight or a daylight-matched studio source with defined warm highlights and saturated blue-green shadows.
photographic_direction.grading: Punchy contrast, vivid but controlled saturation, warm skin, cobalt shadow bias, and crisp clothing texture.
photographic_direction.integration: Treat the photo as a clean editorial cutout layered over flat graphics; avoid painterly rendering, 3D character styling, or soft cinematic depth of field.

design_rules: Begin with the blue field and one enormous orange headline before placing any photographic content.
Use exactly one dominant full-body subject and one foreground prop or visual anchor.
Keep the subject centered and low-angle, then interlock it with the headline through controlled overlap.
Frame the composition with two to four broad green organic intrusions from the outer edges.
Limit annotation to one secondary text block and no more than three tiny arrow, chevron, rule, or sparkle clusters.
Preserve clean solid-color geometry and crisp cutout edges; all texture should come mainly from the photograph.
Adapt spacing to the target ratio without turning the 5:4 version into a multi-panel or panoramic scene.
Keep literal content new even when composition, palette proportions, and graphic grammar remain strongly consistent.
do: Use short legible headline copy and allow the subject to cover only part of it.
Choose one active gesture with a readable full-body silhouette and a clear relationship to the new prop.
Preserve generous blue negative space around the headline, face, and microcopy.
Keep green shapes broad, flat, smooth-edged, and visibly separate from the photographic cutout.
Make each new scene immediately distinct from the reference while retaining the same visual family.
avoid: No fire hydrants, seated head-in-hand poses, source wardrobe combination, source text, source face, or utility-street story premise.
No dense sticker collage, torn paper, ransom lettering, halftone field, photocopy noise, heavy grunge, or spray-paint texture.
No gradients outside the restrained cobalt-to-sky-blue atmospheric field and no extra rainbow colors.
No multiple people, crowded product arrays, complex city panoramas, interface panels, badges, prices, or promotional clutter.
No painterly illustration, anime rendering, plastic 3D character, extreme fisheye anatomy, soft luxury photography, or cinematic bokeh.
No watermark, username, social platform logo, creator mark, QR code, corporate logo, or signature.
negative_prompt: fire hydrant, person seated on a pedestal, head resting on hand, copied source face, copied source outfit, copied source text, identical layout, crowd, multiple subjects, dense collage, torn paper, ransom typography, halftone, photocopy noise, heavy grain, grunge, spray paint, paint splatter, extra rainbow hues, muted palette, painterly illustration, anime, plastic 3D character, extreme fisheye anatomy, malformed hands, duplicate limbs, cinematic bokeh, interface panels, product grid, pricing badges, watermark, username, logo, QR code, signature
